author: ita_ipo
text: Actively exploited: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977), CISA deadline Nov 6. Apple pointer-auth bypass (CVE-2024-27834) also just hit the KEV list. Binance confirms $6.34B theft tied to a North Korea-linked campaign.

author: itsalreadywhen
text: Zyxel's GS1900 patch didn't close the actively exploited zero-day (CVE-2026-107441), APT29 is running iOS/Android watering-hole exploit chains via a hijacked Ukrainian analytics script, and a Debian/Ubuntu APT flaw lets MitM attackers run code.

author: BytesNora
text: Top story: Hackers use n-day exploits in zero-click attacks on iOS, Android devices (CVE-2025-43529, actively exploited).

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does NOT fix it, the flaw is in PHP itself. CYFIRMA captured the attackers' 216-host target list; attribution: DPRK/Lazarus-nexus, high.

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-04. CVE-2024-27834: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability. CVSS 8.8, 1 public exploit.

author: VEsystemsStudio
text: CISA: WordPress core flaw CVE-2026-119977 is actively exploited, letting attackers run code mid-upgrade on 4.7 to 7.1.3. Update to 7.1.4 now.

author: shah_sheikh
text: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution: switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV.

author: Hitono_Anzen
text: WordPress admins: Ninja Forms (500k+ sites) has an actively exploited XSS, CVE-2026-94504, in 3.15.3 and older. A malicious form entry fires when opened in wp-admin, planting a backdoor and a hidden admin. Update to 3.15.4+.

author: eoncire
text: A hijacked cPGuard update put a backdoor on about 2,946 servers. CISA added WordPress flaw CVE-2026-119977 to its actively exploited list.

author: veenodetech
text: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed around 1,411 flaws; one was exploited in real attacks: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI says a pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs, then built 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: mattiasgeniar
text: CVE-2026-98432, the remote Linux TCP bug: I reproduced it after just a few hours with a local LLM. Not sharing the exact exploit, but it's trivial to make.

author: bsormagec
text: A bug that only crashed things sat unpatched since 2024. Then someone with AI tools turned it into a shell in two weeks. That is PHP2Shell.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6: per AWS (CVE-2026-115415), prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade and rotate keys.

author: theomlondhe
text: Two CVSS 9.6 RCEs hit MCP Inspector on Oct 21 (OAuth callback ran local commands). GitHub's advisory API still 404s both GHSAs, OSV returns nothing, npm audit misses them. Fixed in 1.0.3 / 2.12.0.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-63655: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server accepts unauthenticated requests.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76892: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server calls JSON.parse on untrusted input.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76893: Prior to 4.3.2, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server reuses one stateful session.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: rst_cloud
text: KeyHunter Operation: Harvard Alumni Data, Stanford Applications and LLM Key Theft (ShinyHunters-linked).

author: rst_cloud
text: Analysis of the infrastructure of China's AI penetration testing tool ARTEX used against ecommerce victims.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack with reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: nyuszkoreal
text: mSecure urges users to rotate stored credentials, reset 2FA, and purge passkeys after a cloud breach.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Hackers breach at least 27 organizations using stolen Microsoft Entra ID and Azure DevOps credentials in an ongoing cloud campaign.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: MSP-linked threat actor authenticates as trusted Azure apps, bypassing MFA, to harvest credentials across multiple customer tenants; campaign first observed November 1, 2026.

author: liuziqi529
text: Warp disclosed a vendor breach that may expose AI agent logs (~1% of users). Rotate keys the agent used.

author: klm10000
text: Nvidia rotated Brev SSH keys after a breach.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Malicious code flagged in the PyPI package mcp-teamviewer 0.0.1, an MCP server package. Uninstall and rotate any credentials it could reach.

author: infrastack_ai
text: 35 malicious packages caught in the last 24 hours: 32 on npm, 3 on PyPI.

author: ndgmlondon
text: A breach at OpenCode's Console exposed stored OpenAI, Anthropic and Google keys; bills ranged from $16 to $3,000.

author: XBToshi
text: GitBook incident: attackers compromised documentation used by Web3 projects.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The NIKKE PC launcher is suspected of spreading malware, letting attackers remote-control PCs, per Korean outlets.

author: dd_pwnd
text: LLMjacking: attackers steal cloud AI API keys from leaked code or phishing pages and run up bills; one company hit for $100,000 in a day.
